messages.text:
I can’t send the refund to a new card. Refunds can only go to the order’s original payment, even if the old card was cancelled; its issuer handles any credit, and the shop can’t promise where or when it appears. (refund-policy/v2/payment)

The shop’s records show the cordless screwdriver was received back, and the amount paid for it was BRL 150.00. (refund-policy/v2/return) (refund-policy/v2/amount)

If you’d like the refund to go to the original payment, please tell me and I can prepare the proposal.
